channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Maguire facing two-match ban
item.description: Cork captain Ian Maguire is contesting a proposed two-match ban arising from his sending off against Meath last Sunday.

item.title: Bourke looking for Kerry to bounce back
item.description: Kerry manager Mark Bourke is hopeful his charges can bounce back from their double scores loss to neighbours Cork.

item.title: Wet weather forces Westmeath footballers to train in Leitrim
item.description: The Westmeath senior footballers were forced to train in Leitrim last week due to the unavailability of playable pitches in their own county.

item.title: Thurles unavailability sees Tipp set to host Leitrim in Clonmel on Sunday
item.description: This Sunday's Allianz Football League fifth round clash between Tipperary and Leitrim is set to be staged at the Clonmel Sportsfield.

item.title: Elliott hopeful that Carlow result can spur on Saffrons
item.description: Antrim attacker Seaan Elliott is hopeful that last weekend's win over Carlow can now spur the Saffrons on for this season.

item.title: "We have tried to just focus on the positives" - Egan
item.description: Offaly star Cormac Egan is hopeful that the Faithful men can earn their first win of the Allianz Football League campaign when they take on Tyrone this Saturday evening (6pm).

item.title: "We're just going to have to fight our way out of it"
item.description: Tyrone boss Malachy O'Rourke says he hopes the character of his team can come to the fore as they look to bounce back from last weekend's disappointing loss to Louth.

item.title: McGrath hails Kildare progress under Dowling
item.description: Former Tipperary star Shane McGrath believes Kildare are ticking the right boxes to retain their status in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Former Kerry boss Keane joins Aghabullogue backroom team
item.description: Former Kerry and Clare senior football manager Peter Keane has joined the backroom team of Cork club Aghabullogue for the 2026 season.

item.title: Maher milking all she can from farming and starring in Offaly engine room
item.description: Of all the games taking place all across the country on another full weekend of Centra National Camogie League action, the fixture in Birr between Offaly and Down (2pm) is arguably one of, if not the most meaningful.
